name: When is the ideal time to install a backsplash during a kitchen or bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is the ideal time to install a backsplash during a kitchen or bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The ideal time to install a backsplash is typically after the cabinetry and countertops have been installed. This sequence ensures proper measurements and a seamless fit, as the backsplash will sit directly on top of the finished countertop. Our managed process at AKN Design Group carefully coordinates these stages to ensure precise installation and a cohesive final look for your kitchen or luxury bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Backsplashes are usually installed after cabinetry and countertops to ensure a precise, seamless fit.
